name: Apex Textile Company
old_description: Along with comfort and quality, we also give you a huge variety to select exactly what you want. We are updated and keep with trending varities every season.
about:
Apex Textile Company operates from Atlanta, Georgia, bringing over 15 years of industry experience to the institutional textile market. The company was established to serve healthcare, hospitality, industrial, and automotive sectors with a focus on customer satisfaction and product quality.

The company sources and supplies a broad range of textile products, including healthcare linens such as pillowcases, sheets, towels, and blankets; hospitality items like napkins, table tops, and bathroom amenities; industrial textiles such as barmops, shop towels, and aprons; and microfiber products. All products are imported from fabric manufacturers worldwide, allowing Apex to offer a variety of materials including cotton, microfiber, denim, and twill.

Apex serves hospitals, hotels, industrial facilities, and automotive detailing businesses across the Atlanta area. The company notes it supplies "some of the most popular brand across the city," though specific client names are not disclosed.

Apex differentiates itself by emphasizing customer satisfaction as its primary goal, a deep understanding of fabrics, and a commitment to adapting to customer needs efficiently and competitively. The company states it selects products from the finest global fabric manufacturers to ensure comfort and quality.
